## :bug: Bug Description
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## ✅ Expected Behavior
What you expected to happen.

## ❌ Actual Behavior
What actually happened.

## 🔁 Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior, ideally as a minimal snippet:
```python
from proclet import Command

Command("...").args("...").exec()
```

## 🖥️ Environment
- OS: [e.g. macOS 26.x, Ubuntu 24.04, Windows 11]
- Python: [e.g. 3.12.8]
- proclet version / commit: [e.g. 0.1.1 or commit hash]

## 📸 Screenshots / Logs
If applicable, add screenshots, logs, or error messages.

## 🧠 Additional Context
Any other context about the problem (workarounds, frequency, etc.).
